title: Cricket Scoreboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Cricket Scoreboard plugin. Covers international matches (Test/ODI/T20I) and major domestic T20 leagues (IPL, Big Bash, The Hundred, etc.).

enabled.description: Enable or disable the cricket scoreboard plugin

favorite_teams.description: Favorite national teams. Any international series (tour, World Cup, bilateral) featuring one of these teams is discovered and shown. Matches on team name appearing in the series/match name.

favorite_competitions.description: Domestic competitions (keys from competitions.json) to follow. Include 'international' to follow Test/ODI/T20I tours for your favorite_teams.

items.description: Team name or abbreviation to always hide (spoiler protection)

exclude_teams.description: Teams to always hide from live rotation and recent/final scores (spoiler protection). Takes precedence over favorite_teams.

show_favorite_teams_only.description: Only show matches involving a favorite national team. Domestic-league matches are always governed by favorite_competitions.

display_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each match

live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each live match before rotating to the next

non_favorite_live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds for live matches that do NOT involve a favorite team. 0 (default) = use live_game_duration for every live match.

recent_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each recent match

upcoming_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each upcoming match

update_interval_seconds.description: How often to fetch new match data (seconds)

series_discovery_interval.description: How often to re-resolve numeric ESPN series IDs from the header endpoint (seconds). Series IDs change per tour/season, so they are re-discovered periodically rather than hardcoded. Default 24h.

recent_games_to_show.description: Maximum number of recent (completed) matches to show

upcoming_games_to_show.description: Maximum number of upcoming (scheduled) matches to show

live_priority.description: Give live matches priority over other modes. Live matches interrupt normal rotation and are displayed immediately when available.

show_venue.description: Show the venue/ground on upcoming match cards

dynamic_duration.title: Dynamic Duration Settings
dynamic_duration.description: Automatically size each mode's total on-screen time based on how many matches are available.

min_duration_seconds.description: Minimum total duration in seconds for a mode, even if few matches are available

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum total duration in seconds for a mode

mode_durations.title: Mode-Level Durations
mode_durations.description: Control total duration for each mode type. If null, uses dynamic calculation (total_matches x per_match_duration).

live_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Live mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (dynamic).

recent_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Recent mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (dynamic).

upcoming_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Upcoming mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (dynamic).

display_modes.title: Display Modes
display_modes.description: Control which match types to show

celebration_enabled.title: Win Celebration (deprecated)
celebration_enabled.description: Deprecated: ignored. There is no win-celebration screen. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

celebration_duration.title: Win Celebration Duration (deprecated)
celebration_duration.description: Deprecated: ignored. There is no win-celebration screen. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

show_records.title: Show Records (deprecated)
show_records.description: Deprecated: ignored. Team records were never drawn. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

recent_update_interval.title: Recent Update Interval (deprecated)
recent_update_interval.description: Deprecated: ignored. Fetches use update_interval_seconds and live_update_interval. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

upcoming_update_interval.title: Upcoming Update Interval (deprecated)
upcoming_update_interval.description: Deprecated: ignored. Fetches use update_interval_seconds and live_update_interval. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

enabled.description: Deprecated: ignored. The plugin no longer uses the shared background service. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

max_workers.description: Deprecated: ignored. The plugin no longer uses the shared background service. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

max_retries.description: Deprecated: ignored. The plugin no longer uses the shared background service. Kept only so configs that still carry this key keep validating.

customization.title: Display Customization
customization.description: Customize fonts for different text elements on the scoreboard

score_text.title: Match Score
score_text.description: Font settings for the runs/wickets score display

period_text.title: Overs / Session
period_text.description: Font settings for overs, session and day text

team_name.title: Team Names
team_name.description: Font settings for team name abbreviations

status_text.title: Status Messages
status_text.description: Font settings for status text (e.g. result summary, 'Stumps', format badge)

detail_text.title: Details (Run Rate / Target)
detail_text.description: Font settings for run rate, required run rate and target text

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: RGB hex colors for text elements

batting_color.description: Highlight color for the team currently batting

detail_color.description: Color for run rate / target detail text
